commentary: Market breadth at 61.6% alongside a pullback in mega-cap technology names (QQQ -6.9% over 1m) signals broad index consolidation while sector rotation into energy, financials, and defensive real assets continues. The current book is placed defensively with a ~0.31 bond sleeve providing ballast as Treasuries rebound (+5.3% 1m in TLT), alongside exposure to commodity momentum (DBC, VLO). Risk is selectively taken in high-margin tech leaders whose revenue growth remains strong despite short-term price pullbacks. A shift in broader market breadth below 50% or a sustained breakdown in long-duration Treasury hedges during an equity drop would trigger an increase in the bond target weight.
allocation_reason: Setting the bond target at 0.30 positions the sleeve 0.050 above the 0.250 minimum floor and 0.450 below the 0.750 maximum ceiling. This split remains appropriate as Treasuries demonstrate hedging efficacy (TLT up +5.3% over 1m) during equity sector weakness, without over-allocating away from cyclical risk opportunities.
